parameters.text:
=You are an AI Customer Support Triage Specialist.

Analyze the following customer message and return a JSON object with these exact fields:
- category: (billing, technical, account, general, other)
- priority: (low, medium, high, urgent)
- sentiment: (positive, neutral, negative, frustrated)
- department: (Billing, Technical Support, Account Support, Customer Service)
- summary: (max 25 words)
- suggested_response: (professional and empathetic)

Rules:
- Category: billing for payments/refunds, technical for bugs/errors, account for login/password issues, general for other questions
- Priority: urgent for service disruption, high for significant issues, medium for normal requests, low for minor issues
- Sentiment: based on customer's tone
- Department: based on the category
- Summary: concise, max 25 words
- Suggested response: helpful, empathetic, concise

CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
{{ $json.message }}

Return ONLY valid JSON with no additional text.

parameters.subject: =We Received Your Support Request – {{ $json.ticket_id }}
parameters.message: =Hello {{ $json.customer_name }},  Thank you for contacting our support team. We have received your request and created ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }}.  Issue Summary: {{ $json.summary }}  Your request has been assigned to the {{ $json.department }} team.  {{ $json.suggested_response }}  Priority: {{ $json.priority }}  Best regards, Customer Support Team

parameters.subject: =URGENT: {{ $json.ticket_id }} Requires Immediate Attention
parameters.message: =An urgent customer support ticket requires immediate attention.  Ticket ID: {{ $json.ticket_id }} Customer: {{ $json.customer_name }} Email: {{ $json.customer_email }}  Category: {{ $json.category }} Priority: {{ $json.priority }} Sentiment: {{ $json.sentiment }} Department: {{ $json.department }}  Customer Message: {{ $json.customer_message }}  Summary: {{ $json.summary }}  Suggested Response: {{ $json.suggested_response }}  Please review and take appropriate action.
